name: congenital adrenal hyperplasia due to 11-beta-hydroxylase deficiency
description: Congenital adrenal hyperplasia due to 11 beta-hydroxylase (CYP11B1) deficiency is a rare form of congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH) characterized by glucocorticoid deficiency, hyperandrogenism, hypertension and virilization in females.
